## EV charging CMS for CPOs and eMSPs

https://thetrifusion.in/services/ev-charging-app-development
EV charging CMS for CPOs and eMSPs, built in Jaipur for India and worldwide. One charging management system covers CPO software (OCPP 1.6J and 2.0.1: onboarding, remote start/stop, tariffs, load management, alerts, settlement, GST invoice fields) and an eMSP platform (driver accounts, app/RFID tokens, OCPI 2.2.1 roaming, session authorisation, UPI, CDRs, support). The same CMS can run one role or both. Also covers driver apps, the operator dashboard, fleet charging, a white-label EV CMS, ISO 15118 readiness (not a live Plug & Charge claim), and analytics. The pricing page lists a starting range of ₹4,50,000 ex-GST for an MVP; this page does not treat that figure as a fixed package. PlugOne (https://plugone.in) is a live product. There is no separate IoT service page.
